NOT_FOUND.HEADING: 404 Not Found
NOT_FOUND.DESCRIPTION: We’re not able to find that page. It may have been deleted or moved.

GATEWAY_TIMEOUT.HEADING: 504 Gateway Timeout
GATEWAY_TIMEOUT.DESCRIPTION: The server is taking too long to respond. Try again or change your timeout settings.

UNAUTHORIZED.HEADING: 401 Unauthorized
UNAUTHORIZED.DESCRIPTION: Authorization is required to access this page. Check your credentials and try again.

INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR.HEADING: 500 Internal Server Error
INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR.DESCRIPTION: This page is not available right now. Try refreshing the page or try again later.

BAD_REQUEST.HEADING: 400 Bad Request
BAD_REQUEST.DESCRIPTION: Failed to process the request. Check your request and try again.

TEAPOT.HEADING: 418 I’m a Teapot
TEAPOT.DESCRIPTION: The server refuses to brew coffee because, well... it’s a teapot.
